title: lint: hook and job bodies get no compile check — the action-body-does-not-compile rule (#34884) covers script actions only
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (6960988895, item 1). A follow-up of p1 #34884 (PR #34980).

## What happens
PR #34980 adds the gating lint rule `action-body-does-not-compile` for script action bodies inside the runtime wrapper `(async (input, ctx) => { … })`.

Hook and job bodies (`async (ctx) => …`) get no equivalent check. A hook or job body that cannot compile still passes validate, build and verify, and fails only at run time, which is the same failure #34884 fixed for actions.

## Done when
- The same compile check covers hook and job bodies, using their own wrapper shape.
- It is pinned with one uncompilable hook and one uncompilable job.

Grade: **p2 · domain:devx** (theme: MCP, since agents author hooks through the build door). It extends a p1 fix to the neighbouring body kinds. No user is named as hitting it yet.
